name: pyta-checker
description: One-click PythonTA checks: see exactly what python_ta will flag, with PythonTA bundled in. No pip install needed.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: PythonTA Checker runs a Python interpreter and reads PythonTA config files from the workspace, so it only activates in trusted workspaces.

pythonta.runOnSave.description: Check a Python file each time it is saved.

pythonta.runOnOpen.description: Check a Python file when it is opened.

pythonta.configPath.description: PythonTA config file to use when a file has no embedded check_all(config=...). Relative paths resolve against the workspace folder.

enumDescriptions: Use the PythonTA shipped inside the extension.
Prefer the PythonTA installed in the selected interpreter; fall back to the bundled one.
pythonta.importStrategy.description: Which PythonTA to run. Changing this restarts the server.

pythonta.interpreter.description: Absolute path to a Python 3.10+ executable. Overrides the Python extension's selected interpreter. Changing this restarts the server.

pythonta.hideOtherPythonDiagnostics.description: Hide Pylance and basedpyright problems so only PythonTA's show. Autocomplete keeps working. Toggle with the 'PythonTA: Toggle Only-PythonTA Problems' command.

pythonta.trace.server.description: Trace the communication between VS Code and the PythonTA language server.

scripts.pretest:integration: node -e "if(!require('fs').existsSync('bundled/libs/python_ta')){console.error('bundled/libs is missing: run \"python scripts/bundle.py build\" first');process.exit(1)}"
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && npm run compile-tests && vscode-test
scripts.test: npm run check-types && npm run lint && npm run test:unit
